intro.ja: 楕円 {eq} について答えよ。

text.en: What is the length of the major axis?

explain.ja:
a² = {big} より a = {=sqrt(big)}
長軸の長さは 2a = {answer}
explain.en:
a² = {big}, so a = {=sqrt(big)}
The major axis is 2a = {answer}

text.en: What is the length of the minor axis?

explain.ja:
b² = {small} より b = {=sqrt(small)}
短軸の長さは 2b = {answer}
explain.en:
b² = {small}, so b = {=sqrt(small)}
The minor axis is 2b = {answer}

text.ja: 焦点を (±c, 0) とするとき、c の値は?(c > 0)
text.ko: 초점을 (±c, 0) 이라 할 때, c 의 값은? (c > 0)
text.en: If the foci are (±c, 0), what is c? (c > 0)

explain.ja:
楕円では c² = a² − b² = {big} − {small} = {=big-small}(足さない)
c = √{=big-small} = {answer}
explain.ko:
타원에서는 c² = a² − b² = {big} − {small} = {=big-small} (더하지 않습니다)
c = √{=big-small} = {answer}
explain.en:
For an ellipse c² = a² − b² = {big} − {small} = {=big-small} (do not add)
c = √{=big-small} = {answer}
